item.title: Show HN: Skybits – A document editor for humans and agents
item.summary: Our business team were heavy users of ChatGPT's canvas feature, but it wasn't very useful once we needed to share a canvas and edit it collaboratively. Some team members were also using a different AI, and we couldn't find a good way to work on docs without sending each other .md files. So we built Skybits to solve that problem. It's free, AI-agnostic, and supports documents, spreadsheets, and HTML. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49334358 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
